topic: Debugging data aggregation for company metrics
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on troubleshooting an issue where a data aggregation process failed to produce expected results. [p1] provided details, including the company ID (7898), dataset name (model1), and date range (starting 2023-08-10). The initial query was run against `allunite.device_session_agg_ml_staging` using a specific facility number (26994), but no data was returned.

[p1] attempted to resolve the issue by simply changing the company filter while keeping other parameters constant. [me] agreed to review the corrected query later or the next morning.
decisions: The investigation into the failed data aggregation process will be postponed until the following day.
